facts.value: The Study Service Point and the hotline are your central contacts for questions regarding studies, applications, and student administration.
The central study advising offers competent support for all matters related to studying and study selection.
What matters is potential, not the hurdle. Discover our support services for your individual educational path.
The Student Secretariat is your reliable contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
For bachelor theses, exam registrations, or certificates – you can find contact persons for all formal matters regarding your academic achievements at the examination offices.
Goethe University offers a global perspective, with programs and services that bring together national and international students and enrich your academic experience.
The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) with job placement. Strengthen your career skills through workshops, coaching, and networking.
Consultation in cases of discrimination as well as measures for the prevention and reduction of discrimination.
Ombudspersons are your contacts for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding studies and promotion.
The Student Union offers affordable accommodation near the campus. Discover numerous dormitories, find out about rental prices, and apply directly online for your room.
The Student Union provides information on all options for study financing, including BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans.
